input.brief: Plan a 15-second silent mini-story about a desk lamp finding a lost pencil. Three shots of five seconds each, the same two characters throughout, warm practical lighting, no dialogue or written text. Give clear camera directions and a beginning, obstacle and resolution.

characters.description: A small articulated desk lamp with a rounded metal shade, warm yellow bulb, and a flexible neck. It moves by tilting and swiveling its head, expressing curiosity and care through light and motion.
A short wooden pencil with a graphite tip and a pink eraser, slightly worn. It is inanimate but can roll, wobble, and be nudged, appearing lost and helpless.

shots.camera: High-angle medium shot, slowly pushing in toward the lamp and pencil.
shots.description: Beginning: The desk lamp is on, casting a warm pool of light on a tidy desk. The pencil lies just outside the light, barely visible in shadow. The lamp tilts its head downward, noticing the pencil, and its light flickers with interest.

shots.camera: Low-angle close-up on the lamp’s shade and the pencil, with a slight handheld sway to emphasize strain.
shots.description: Obstacle: The lamp stretches its neck toward the pencil, but the pencil is too far. It tries to extend further, straining, and its light dims slightly from the effort. The pencil wobbles but does not move closer.

shots.camera: Medium shot from a side angle, slowly pulling back as the pencil rolls into the light.
shots.description: Resolution: The lamp swivels its head to aim a bright beam directly at the pencil. The pencil, now illuminated, rolls gently toward the lamp into the warm light. The lamp tilts down, satisfied, and its light softens to a cozy glow.

plan.style: Warm practical lighting, silent pantomime, cozy desk environment, soft shadows, no dialogue or written text.
plan.title: The Lamp and the Lost Pencil

input.brief: Plan a 12-second quiet film about an origami bird unfolding into a letter. Three four-second shots, one recurring character, no readable writing, no speech, consistent paper texture and morning light. Make the transformation visually clear.

characters.description: A small origami bird made of textured, cream-colored paper with subtle fibers. It has sharp creases and a delicate, folded form. As it unfolds, it flattens into a rectangular letter, but the paper texture and warm morning light remain consistent.

shots.camera: Static close-up, shallow depth of field
shots.description: Close-up of the origami bird resting on a wooden windowsill. Morning sunlight streams in, casting soft shadows. The bird's paper texture is visible, with gentle highlights on the folds.

shots.camera: Slow dolly in, maintaining focus on the unfolding paper
shots.description: The origami bird begins to unfold. Its wings slowly flatten and spread outward, the creases softening as the paper transforms. The motion is smooth and continuous, with the paper texture and lighting remaining consistent.

shots.camera: Static medium shot, slight pull back to reveal the letter in context
shots.description: The paper has fully unfolded into a flat letter, lying on the windowsill. The morning light casts a warm glow, and the paper's texture is clearly visible. The letter is blank, with no readable writing.

plan.style: Quiet, minimalist paper animation with soft morning light, warm tones, and a consistent textured paper aesthetic. No readable writing, no speech. Emphasis on gentle, fluid transformation.
plan.title: Unfolding Morning
